subject: POC kickoff: stalled setup — quick recheck & options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ella Thompson <ella@edenhealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff: stalled setup — quick recheck & options

Hey Ella — thanks again for the call yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

What we covered:
- Goal: 2-week evaluation to validate inference latency and cost on your clinical triage workload
- Required work: VPC peering + firewall rules, sample dataset upload (anonymized), SSO (okta) for team access
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency under 300ms, token cost target <= $0.005/token for the workload profile

Outstanding action items (your side):
1) IT to provision VPC peering and allow outbound to 34.120.45.78 and 34.120.45.79 (redwood egress)
2) Upload anonymized sample CSV to the shared folder (instructions in POC-checklist.xlsx)
3) Decide whether you want Hosted Sandbox (fast) or VPC peering (secure) for first validation

From our side we will:
- Share the sandbox API key and a minimal notebook for quick smoke tests
- Provide a short managed onboarding session if you want help with sample ingestion and SSO

I noticed there's been no activity in the POC dashboard this week (no token usage). Can you confirm whether this is still a priority for Eden Health this quarter, or if we should pause the setup for now?

If you are still prioritizing it, I can set up a 30-minute troubleshooting session next week (suggested times below) or temporarily spin up a hosted sandbox to unblock verification while IT completes peering.

Suggested 30-min slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-07-21 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-07-22 14:00–14:30

Attachments: POC-checklist.xlsx, network-reqs.pdf

Thanks — let me know what works.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Ella Thompson <ella@edenhealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: EdenHealth IT <it@edenhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-07-27T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: stalled setup — quick recheck & options

Hi Karthik — apologies for the radio silence. Internal security has flagged external peering and IT is prioritizing a separate SOC review this week. For transparency: our compliance lead is asking for the full list of egress IPs and expected S3 endpoints so they can complete the review.

Can you send a concise list of IPs and any notes about data retention/ logging for the sandbox? Also — would it be possible to do an initial smoke test without peering (hosted sandbox) while IT finishes? If so, what limitations should we expect?

Cc'ing our IT team so they have context.

Thanks —
Ella Thompson
Product Manager, Data Platforms | Eden Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ella Thompson <ella@edenhealth.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, EdenHealth IT <it@edenhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-07-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: stalled setup — quick recheck & options

Hi Ella (and IT team) — thanks for the update. Quick answers inline and an offer to help accelerate: 

- Egress IPs: 34.120.45.78, 34.120.45.79. TLS-only, no inbound.
- S3 endpoints: we use region-us.redwood-storage.com for sample upload. Files are deleted after the POC unless you request retention; we can enable auto-delete.
- Logging & retention: we retain minimal inference audit logs for 30 days for debugging; can be disabled/forwarded to your SIEM on request.

To avoid blocking the POC: we can provision a temporary hosted sandbox (no peering required) that you can use for the first smoke tests. Limitations: data will traverse our hosted environment (TLS), there will be a 10k token/day limit on the trial sandbox, and SSO won't be available until SAML is configured.

Operational option: Redwood can provide one week of Managed Onboarding (hands-on help from our CS engineer) at no charge to troubleshoot sample ingestion and get an initial pass of the eval. If you want to accept that, I can have a CS engineer join the first 30-min session and provision a sandbox API key immediately.

Proposed times for a 30-min troubleshooting call (PDT):
- Tue 2026-08-03 09:00–09:30
- Thu 2026-08-05 11:00–11:30

Attachment: managed-onboarding-offer.txt (details of the complimentary week).

—Karthik

Thanks — that sounds good. We'd like to take the hosted sandbox route to unblock the initial validation and accept the complimentary week of Managed Onboarding.

Can you provision a temporary API key and schedule the 30-min onboarding for Thu 2026-08-05 at 11:00 PDT? If that slot doesn't work for your CS, alternative Tue 08/03 09:00 is ok. Also please send a short one-pager on data handling (retention/ deletion) so our compliance lead can close the note.

We'll also attach an internal MOU (non-binding) that authorizes the sandbox for evaluation — attaching signed-mou.pdf.

Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to getting this moving.

—Ella
